prompts.label: Template prompt
prompts.text: Use the photo as the main character and keep them exactly as photographed: the same face, hair or fur, skin tone, build and the clothes they are wearing. They stand in an empty paved parking lot on a cloudy day, trees and a low fence behind them, holding a plain black smartphone close to their mouth like someone sending a voice message. Handheld phone footage, waist-up, one continuous take, vertical 9:16. (1) They speak into the phone, hopeful and dead serious: "ChatGPT, how I become a millionaire in 30 days?"; (2) the phone answers in a flat, calm assistant voice: "Get a job."; (3) they lower the phone, stare at the screen in disbelief, then look straight into the camera and say, offended: "Bro, what are they talking about?" Mouth moving with every line, natural outdoor sound, no music. Plain phone with a blank screen, no app logo. No text, no captions, no logos, no watermark.
